commit_message:
[Codegen] Compare binding ordinals only within one pipeline layout

A binding ordinal is an index into the binding list of a specific pipeline
layout, so ordinals from two different layouts describe unrelated positions.
mayAlias compared them anyway and reported binding(0) of one layout and
binding(1) of another as disjoint.

Two subspans reach the ordinal comparison whenever both operands resolve to a
binding, so the case never fell through to the AliasAnalysis fallback. Treat
differing layouts as may-alias and record the case in the table.

[Flow] Fix tensor folding for parameter attributes

TensorSliceOp::fold and TensorUpdateOp::fold assume that fully folded
tensor operands are ElementsAttr values. However, #flow.parameter.named
folds to a parameter attribute instead, resulting in invalid casts.

Skip folding when the required operands are not ElementsAttr values and
add regression coverage for slicing and updating parameter-backed
tensors.

Fixes #24751
